'''Kuati marble''' was a type of highly expensive [[Marble/Legends|marble]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. It was [[Color/Legends|colored]] white with a tint of blue. It was also inset with gilt flecks.<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>
